name: 39208 · Pearl, MS
findings: ZIP 39208 (Pearl) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39208 (Pearl) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 39208 (Pearl) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).
